scripts.build: bun run --parallel --filter @neoverse-ui/tokens --filter @neoverse-ui/motion --filter @neoverse-ui/overlay-runtime --filter @neoverse-ui/glass-runtime build && bun run --parallel --filter @neoverse-ui/giscus-theme --filter @neoverse-ui/tailwind --filter @neoverse-ui/vue --filter @neoverse-ui/react build && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/playground build
scripts.build:types: bun run --parallel --filter @neoverse-ui/tokens --filter @neoverse-ui/motion --filter @neoverse-ui/overlay-runtime --filter @neoverse-ui/glass-runtime build && bun run --parallel --filter @neoverse-ui/vue --filter @neoverse-ui/react build
scripts.test:e2e:cross-browser: bun run build && bunx playwright test --config=playwright.cross-browser.config.ts --workers=2 --reporter=line
scripts.lint: bun run --parallel lint:biome lint:text lint:language check:docs check:budgets lint:style lint:tailwind check:contracts
scripts.check:contracts: bun run check:materials && bun scripts/gates/check-component-contracts.ts && bun run check:component-layout && bun scripts/gates/check-framework-parity.ts && bun run check:test-registry && bun run check:requests
scripts.test:consumer-sync: bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/tokens build && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/giscus-theme build && bun test scripts/sync/sync-consumer.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:types && bun run typecheck:only
scripts.typecheck:only: bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/tokens typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/motion typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/overlay-runtime typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/glass-runtime typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/vue typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/react typecheck && bun run --filter @neoverse-ui/playground typecheck && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@neoverse-ui/*' --if-present --sequential test && bun run test:requests && bun run test:contracts && bun run test:consumer-sync && bun run test:release-tools
scripts.release:check: biome check . && bun run check:changesets && bun run lint:text && bun run lint:language && bun run check:docs && bun run check:budgets && bun run lint:style && bun run lint:tailwind && bun run check:contracts && bun run build && bun run typecheck:only && bun run test && bun run verify:packages
